edit_denied: Only the GM or the entry's owner can edit it.
owner_gm_only: Only the GM assigns an entry's owner.
hidden_gm_only: Only the GM decides what is hidden from the table.
status_factions_only: status is tracked only for factions
archive_denied: Only the GM or the entry's owner can archive it.
purge_gm_only: Only the GM can delete permanently.
player_no_gm_vis: A player can't set the visibility to “GM only”.
self_link: An entry can't be linked to itself.
link_edit_denied: Only the GM or someone who can see one of the entries can edit the link.
link_delete_denied: Only the GM or someone who can see one of the entries can delete the link.
block_not_yours: Only the note's author or the GM can edit it.
gm_note_delete: The GM created this note — only the GM can delete it.
note_delete_denied: Only the note's author or the GM can delete it.
note_not_yours: Only the GM may edit or delete someone else's note.
